description:
A Windows utility for tweaking, optimizing, and customizing your system.

Winchisel is a Windows utility for tweaking, optimizing, and customizing your system. It includes a debloater, performance and privacy tweaks, app downloads, process tools, a startup manager, scheduled-task management, and extras — with risk badges, recommended defaults, and automatic updates.
